newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Statue vanishes after 24 hours in Argentine park.
newsitem.headline: Statue vanishes after 24 hours in Argentine park.

text.p: A life-size sculpture of a woman disappeared from a park in a posh Buenos Aires area, just 24 hours after the work was unveiled by the city's mayor.
Police said the white marble statue was stolen in the early hours of Thursday from a park in the Recoleta area in the capital.
The statue, donated by the Bank of Montevideo, was described by the mayor as both "a symbol of unity and friendship between Argentina and Uruguay" and "a song of hope based on beauty."
It was the work of Uruguayan artist Jose Belloni and weighed 880 pounds (400 kg).
Police suspect a group of people dressed up as municipal workers carried off the statue before dawn.
